SELECT
      timezone('UTC', "fi_invoices".as_of_date::timestamptz) "fi_invoices__as_of_date"
    FROM
      (SELECT i.*, CASE i.revenue_stream
  WHEN 'Contracting' THEN least((SELECT max(issue_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__invoices WHERE issue_date < current_date),
                                (SELECT max(payment_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__payments WHERE payment_date < current_date))
  ELSE (SELECT max(issue_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__service_invoices WHERE issue_date < current_date) END AS as_of_date
FROM marts.fct_invoices i) AS "fi_invoices"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', "fi_invoices".due_date::timestamptz) "fi_invoices__due_date"
    FROM
      (SELECT i.*, CASE i.revenue_stream
  WHEN 'Contracting' THEN least((SELECT max(issue_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__invoices WHERE issue_date < current_date),
                                (SELECT max(payment_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__payments WHERE payment_date < current_date))
  ELSE (SELECT max(issue_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__service_invoices WHERE issue_date < current_date) END AS as_of_date
FROM marts.fct_invoices i) AS "fi_invoices"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', "fi_invoices".issue_date::timestamptz) "fi_invoices__issue_date"
    FROM
      (SELECT i.*, CASE i.revenue_stream
  WHEN 'Contracting' THEN least((SELECT max(issue_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__invoices WHERE issue_date < current_date),
                                (SELECT max(payment_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__payments WHERE payment_date < current_date))
  ELSE (SELECT max(issue_date) FROM staging.stg_netvisor__service_invoices WHERE issue_date < current_date) END AS as_of_date
FROM marts.fct_invoices i) AS "fi_invoices"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

cubes.description: Every Nordlund LVI Oy invoice: contracting invoices (Netvisor sales module) and maintenance-contract invoices (Netvisor service module), with the ex-VAT amount, the current outstanding balance and the customer. The Netvisor sales-invoice sync last landed invoices dated 2026-06-05, so contracting revenue here stops in June 2026 while service-contract invoices run to August. Outstanding balances are only as current as the feed that reports their payments: as_of_date is that day per row, and overdue is aged against it, never against today.

dimensions.description: unpaid as of the row's as_of_date (its feed's data end); 0 when paid
dimensions.name: fi_invoices.outstanding_eur_value
dimensions.title: fi invoices outstanding_eur (the column)

dimensions.description: the last day the row's feed holds - its outstanding balance and overdue status are as of the close of this day (contracting stops with the Netvisor sales-invoice / payment sync; service invoices have their own)
dimensions.name: fi_invoices.as_of_date
dimensions.title: fi invoices As of Date

dimensions.description: days an unpaid invoice is past its due date on its as_of_date (its feed's data end; 0 when paid or not yet due; Netvisor's own aging convention, raw_netvisor.ar_aging) - for "more than N days overdue" filter days_overdue > N, never due_date against today
dimensions.name: fi_invoices.days_overdue
dimensions.title: fi invoices Days Overdue

dimensions.description: service line (Bathroom renovation, Heating system, Maintenance contract, ...)
dimensions.name: fi_invoices.service
dimensions.title: fi invoices Service
